display.summary: Logout honours a mounted URL prefix, projects can name their own logout destination, and a detail modal renders a model's own computed rows without forking the partial.
highlights: Logout resolved through the URLconf: a project mounting dlux under /staff/ no longer lands on a 404.
New DLUX_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL lets a project set its own logout destination, which Django's own setting cannot do here.
Detail modals render extra_detail_fields from get_modal_context(), retiring the forked partial projects needed for computed rows.
